payload.name: ResolveRelativeWeekendDateRanges
payload.description: When extracting an event whose time is stated as 'last weekend', 'this weekend', or 'next weekend' relative to the message timestamp, use this to resolve the correct Saturday-Sunday range before storing the memory.
content: When a candidate event contains a relative weekend phrase ('last weekend', 'this weekend', 'next weekend'), resolve it against the message timestamp as a Saturday-to-Sunday range: 'last weekend' = the Sat-Sun immediately preceding the message date; 'this weekend' = the Sat-Sun containing the message date if it falls on Sat/Sun, otherwise the upcoming Sat-Sun; 'next weekend' = the Sat-Sun after 'this weekend'. Never include Monday in the weekend range.

Store the resolved Saturday and Sunday dates in world_start/world_end and in the memory content. If the intended weekend is ambiguous, preserve the source phrase in the content instead of inventing a shifted date.

solves: Extraction sometimes miscalculates relative weekend references, shifting events by a day (e.g., treating 'last weekend' as Sunday-Monday instead of Saturday-Sunday). This Skill applies when constructing event memories from messages that use 'last/this/next weekend' and need a Saturday-Sunday range anchored to the message timestamp. It does not apply to absolute dates, named holidays, or multi-day events that are not weekend-relative.
